engine::TouchEvent.name: engine::TouchEvent
engine::TouchEvent.brief: Platform-neutral touch event in world coordinates.

engine::Scene.name: engine::Scene

methods.name: onBack
methods.brief: System back. Return true if consumed; false lets the app exit.

engine::Scene.brief: One screen of the app (menu, a mini game, result). The engine drives exactly one scene at a time.

methods.name: render
methods.brief: Fills `frames` mono samples into `out` (already interleaved by the caller if stereo).

engine::Mixer.brief: Polyphonic sample mixer. play() is called from the game thread, render() from the audio callback; voices are claimed with atomics so neither side blocks. Sounds must outlive any voice playing them.

engine::Timer.name: engine::Timer

methods.name: reset
methods.brief: Call after a pause so the next tick does not include the paused time.

engine::Timer.brief: Frame timer. tick() returns the seconds elapsed since the previous tick, clamped so a long pause (app switch, debugger) does not explode physics.

engine::Sprite.name: engine::Sprite
engine::Sprite.brief: A rectangular region of a texture, in normalized UV coordinates, plus the region's size in pixels so callers can draw it at native scale.

engine::Texture.name: engine::Texture

methods.name: create
methods.brief: Allocates an empty texture; contents are undefined until upload().

methods.name: upload
methods.brief: Copies a rectangle of RGBA8 pixels into the texture.

engine::Texture.brief: GPU texture (RGBA8). Owns the GL object.

engine::Rect.name: engine::Rect
engine::Rect.brief: Axis-aligned rectangle. Origin is the top-left corner; y grows downward, matching screen coordinates.

engine::SpriteBatch.name: engine::SpriteBatch

methods.name: begin
methods.brief: worldWidth/worldHeight define the orthographic projection for this frame. `offset` shifts everything drawn (used for screen shake) without touching any game-side positions.

methods.name: draw
methods.brief: Draws `sprite` centred at `center`, scaled to `size` world units. rotation is radians, clockwise on screen. flipX mirrors horizontally.

methods.name: drawRect
methods.brief: Solid rectangle (uses an internal 1x1 white texture).

methods.name: drawQuad
methods.brief: Solid rotated quad centred at `center`.

engine::SpriteBatch.brief: Accumulates textured quads and submits them in as few draw calls as possible. A flush happens when the bound texture changes or the buffer fills up.

engine::TextureAtlas.name: engine::TextureAtlas

methods.name: add
methods.brief: Loads a PNG from assets and packs it under `name`. Returns false if the file is missing or the atlas is full.

methods.name: get
methods.brief: Looks up a packed sprite; returns an invalid Sprite if unknown.

engine::Haptics.name: engine::Haptics
engine::Haptics.brief: Vibration feedback. The Android implementation goes through JNI; the default no-op keeps games free of null checks.

engine::Engine.name: engine::Engine

methods.name: setHaptics
methods.brief: Platform services. Optional; defaults are no-ops.

methods.name: initGraphics
methods.brief: Must be called with a current GL context.

methods.name: setSafeInsets
methods.brief: Display cutout / system bar insets in screen pixels; HUD avoids them.

methods.brief: One update + render pass. Caller swaps buffers afterwards.

methods.brief: Call after a pause so the next frame's dt is not the paused duration.

methods.brief: Screen shake: trauma accumulates (0..1) and decays; the visual offset is trauma^2 so small hits barely move and big hits punch. Game positions are never touched, only the projection.

methods.name: hitStop
methods.brief: Hit-stop: freezes scene updates for `seconds` of real time.

methods.name: onTouch
methods.brief: Screen-space touch (pixels) -> world-space, forwarded to the scene.

methods.name: onBack
methods.brief: Returns true if the scene consumed the back press.

engine::Engine.brief: Platform-independent core: owns the renderer, the sprite atlas, the audio mixer and the active scene, and maps screen pixels to a fixed-width world.

engine::AssetLoader.name: engine::AssetLoader

methods.name: readFile
methods.brief: Returns the whole file, or an empty vector if it does not exist.

engine::AssetLoader.brief: Platform-neutral file access. The Android implementation reads from the APK's AAssetManager; a desktop build could read from disk.

engine::Image.name: engine::Image

methods.name: load
methods.brief: Decodes a PNG/JPG via stb_image. Returns an invalid Image on failure.

engine::Image.brief: Decoded RGBA8 pixels in CPU memory.

engine::Animation.name: engine::Animation

methods.brief: Collects frames named "<prefix>_01", "<prefix>_02", ... (two-digit index) from the atlas until one is missing.

engine::Animation.brief: A sequence of atlas sprites played at a fixed frame rate.

engine::Font.name: engine::Font

methods.brief: Bakes ASCII plus the UTF-8 extraGlyphs into the shared atlas.

methods.brief: `size` is the line height in world units.

methods.name: measure
methods.brief: Width in world units of `text` at `size`.

engine::Font.brief: Bitmap font baked from a TTF with stb_truetype into the shared atlas. Glyphs are baked once at kBakePixelHeight and scaled when drawn, which is fine for the sizes a phone HUD uses.

engine::Particles.name: engine::Particles
engine::Particles.brief: Lightweight CPU particle pool: bursts of squares (or a sprite) with gravity, drag, spin and fade. Enough for dust, confetti and hit sparks.

app::Sfx.name: app::Sfx
app::Sfx.brief: Every sound effect in the game, synthesised at startup (no audio files).

app::castle::CastleModel.name: app::castle::CastleModel
app::castle::CastleModel.brief: Deterministic simulation, independent of graphics and Android. A fixed-size actor pool keeps battle updates allocation-free; permanent state saves at player actions and settlement. Interrupted battles

platform::android::AndroidAssetLoader.brief: Reads files packed into the APK's assets/ directory.
